answer: First each identity locks a $50 bond and a violet commitment hash on-ledger before answering, tying every grade to a public slash trail. The verifier then compares the submitted grade with the jury consensus and burns $25 from any identity whose score diverges by more than 1 point on 3 vertex answers or whose mirror trail is incomplete. One honest agent risks a single $50 bond and one 2 GB audit log; 10 fakes must lock $500 across 10 bonds and 20 GB of logs. Repeated divergence slashes the full bond and freezes the identity.
